title: What a Norwegian sales document states
source: Forskrift om bokføring (FOR-2004-12-01-1558) §§ 5-1-1 to 5-1-5, in force 2026-10-09; lov 20. juni 2025 nr. 106 om Foretaksregisteret § 7-2 for the register named on an AS or ASA's documents (in force 2026-01-01; § 10-2 of the 1985 act, which the regulation's own text still cites, before it), and the word Foretaksregisteret from the regulation itself; Peppol NO-R-001 and NO-R-002 (cited) for the same in EHF. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The seller's name and organisasjonsnummer (modulus 11), followed by MVA when it charges VAT, and Foretaksregisteret for an AS, ASA or NUF, on the page; in the UBL the VAT number NO<org.nr.>MVA and Foretaksregisteret under TAX.

Number and date, the buyer, the time and place of delivery, the due date, the VAT in Norwegian kroner and per rate, and "Omvendt avgiftsplikt – Merverdiavgift ikke beregnet" for a reverse charge, on the page.
